title: Business structure galat chuni toh ghar bhi ja sakta hai?
hooks: Business structure galat chuni toh ghar bhi ja sakta hai
Proprietorship mein karz aapka, ghar bhi ja sakta hai
Funding chahiye toh Pvt Ltd hi kyun? Baaki sab fail
hook_why: Direct high-stakes claim about personal asset risk — matches top-performing 'urgent interruption' hook pattern; visual of house cracking works sound-off
metaphor: Protection Shield — each structure is a different level of shield between business risk and your personal assets (house, savings, car)

scenes.vo: Business structure galat chuni toh ghar bhi ja sakta hai
scenes.prompt: Indian middle-class house at night, single crack appears on wall glowing red, camera pushes in fast
scenes.title: Business structure galat chuni
scenes.bg_prompt: Indian middle-class house exterior at night, clean photoreal, pure black background

scenes.vo: Paanch structure, sirf teen bachate aapko
scenes.label: INTRO
scenes.bg_prompt: Five geometric shields in row on pure black, first two cracked, last three solid, premium studio lighting

scenes.vo: Proprietorship — aap hi business, karz bhi aapka
scenes.prompt: One person behind cracked shield, red debt arrows piercing through to hit person directly
scenes.title: Proprietorship — aap hi
scenes.bg_prompt: One silhouette, broken shield, red arrows passing through, photoreal on pure black

scenes.vo: Partnership — do log, karz dono ka, ek bhaage toh doosra phanse
scenes.prompt: Two people behind cracked shield, debt arrows hitting both, one fading leaving other taking double hit
scenes.title: Partnership — do log,
scenes.bg_prompt: Two silhouettes, joint cracked shield, arrows splitting to hit both, one disappearing, pure black

scenes.vo: LLP — alag entity, limited liability, shield pakka
scenes.prompt: Two partners behind solid glowing shield, debt arrows bouncing off, partners safe inside
scenes.title: LLP — alag entity,
scenes.bg_prompt: Two silhouettes, solid blue shield deflecting red arrows, photoreal on pure black

scenes.vo: OPC — ek founder, company status, shield chota par mazboot
scenes.prompt: Single founder behind compact solid shield, debt arrows deflecting, company badge on shield
scenes.title: OPC — ek founder,
scenes.bg_prompt: One silhouette, compact hexagonal shield with badge, arrows deflecting, pure black

scenes.vo: Pvt Ltd — VC funding ke liye bani, sabse mazboot shield
scenes.prompt: Multiple shareholders behind multi-layered fortress shield, green investment arrows entering controlled gate, red debt arrows blocked
scenes.title: Pvt Ltd — VC
scenes.bg_prompt: Group silhouettes, layered shield with gate for green arrows, red arrows blocked, premium render

scenes.vo: Liability test — Prop aur Partner: unlimited, baaki: limited
scenes.label: LIABILITY
scenes.bg_prompt: Split screen: left cracked shield person exposed, right solid shield person safe, pure black

scenes.vo: Funding chahiye? Sirf Pvt Ltd le sakta VC equity
scenes.label: FUNDING
scenes.bg_prompt: Green arrow entering Pvt Ltd gate, bouncing off other shields, photoreal

scenes.vo: Compliance — Prop 1, Partnership 2, LLP 4, OPC 5, Pvt Ltd 8 filings saal
scenes.title: PVT LTD 8 FILINGS
scenes.bg_prompt: Clean HUD bar chart rising left to right on pure black, mono chrome

scenes.vo: Decision — risk high ya funding chahiye? Pvt Ltd banao. Warna LLP ya OPC
scenes.label: DECISION
scenes.bg_prompt: Clean flowchart on pure black, decision diamonds, green yes paths to Pvt Ltd, blue paths to LLP OPC

scenes.vo: Aaj hi CA se baat karo, structure fix karo, ghar bachao
scenes.label: ACTION
scenes.bg_prompt: Clean card on pure black, yellow accent line, subtle phone screen reflection

scenes.vo: Save karo, share karo, agla video dekhna mat bhoolna
scenes.label: END
scenes.bg_prompt: Clean end card on pure black, KaiseTech handle, yellow accent

caption:
Business structure galat chuni toh ghar bhi ja sakta hai 🏠

Prop, Partnership, LLP, OPC, Pvt Ltd — kaunsi shield tumhare assets bachayegi?

Aaj hi CA se baat karo, structure fix karo, ghar bachao

Save karo, share karo

#KaiseTech #BusinessStructure #StartupIndia #LLP #PvtLtd #FounderTips

claims.claim: Sole proprietorship and partnership have unlimited personal liability
claims.basis: Companies Act 2013; Indian Partnership Act 1932; MCA guidelines

claims.claim: LLP, OPC, and Private Limited are separate legal entities with limited liability
claims.basis: Limited Liability Partnership Act 2008; Companies Act 2013 Section 2(68); MCA notifications

claims.claim: Only Private Limited companies can raise venture capital equity via CCPS
claims.basis: SEBI ICDR Regulations 2018; Companies Act 2013 Section 62; standard VC term sheet practice

claims.claim: OPC has only one shareholder and must convert to Pvt Ltd to add investors
claims.basis: Companies Act 2013 Section 2(62); Rule 3 of Companies (Incorporation) Rules 2014

claims.claim: Annual compliance filings increase from Proprietorship (1) to Private Limited (8+)
claims.basis: MCA annual return forms MGT-7, AOC-4; LLP Form 11, 8; GST returns; Income Tax returns; typical filing counts per structure
